definitions.token_repetition_rate: mean(1 - unique normalized output tokens / normalized output tokens)
definitions.question_copy_ratio: mean(output tokens also appearing in the raw LongBench question / output tokens)
definitions.answer_wrapped_or_explained_rate: output wraps a reference answer with extra text, or contains an explanation discourse cue
definitions.empty_or_missing_rate: empty normalized output or missing stored generation length; EOS finish reasons are not stored
definitions.max_length_rate: stored gen_length >= configured max generation length
